chunk.content: The Indonesian name Kembung is also a local name of the Indian mackerel Rastrelliger kanagurta, a similar species of the same genus; island mackerel is caught along with the other Rastrelliger species, separate statistics are not reported for it, and some local names of the other two Rastrelliger species may apply to R. faughni.
chunk.source_quote: Separate statistics are not reported for Island mackerel, but it is taken along with other species of Rastrelliger off Taiwan Island, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Malaysia. ... Local Names : INDONESIA: Kembung ... some of the local names here given for the other two species of Rastrelliger and for Scomber australasicus may apply to R. faughni in some localities. ... Rastrelliger kanagurta ... INDONESIA: Banjar, Kembung, Kembunglelaki

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2. Scombrids of the World (Collette & Nauen, 1983), FAO Fisheries Synopsis No. 125
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
